capabilities.title: Bounded structure repair with fidelity evidence
Validated family data and template inputs
Cross-lane job outcomes and audit evidence
Cross-lane safe failure and privacy controls

requirements.text: Characterize input PDFs without silently changing source content; supported inputs and profiles remain open.
Cover statements, invoices, correspondence, and reports with synthetic or deidentified fixtures.
Record preservation evidence for visible text, pagination, geometry, links, forms, annotations, and metadata where applicable.
Limit automated repairs to explicitly supported structural cases; preserve an original and report unsupported inputs.
Ambiguous reading order, tables, figures, or meaning must produce a review-needed outcome rather than a guessed semantic repair.
Machine validation, human semantic review, and assistive-technology review have separately recorded outcomes.
Remediation candidate output is machine-checked against the explicit PDF/UA-2 profile without fallback; the result is separate from semantic and assistive-technology review.
Validate required fields, types, arithmetic rules, and template bindings before rendering; family schemas and business rules remain open.
Generation input examples cover statements, invoices, correspondence, and reports using synthetic or deidentified data.
Render semantic structure and family content from validated inputs while preserving declared source meaning.
Keep the PDF engine and DOCX/Markdown conversion support behind evidence-backed feasibility decisions.
Generated output is independently validated and not described as compliant from tags or a machine pass alone.
Generated PDF output is machine-checked with explicit PDF/UA-2 profile selection and no fallback; semantic and assistive-technology outcomes remain separate.
Each job has a traceable status, failure class, artifact identity, and review state without exposing document content in ordinary diagnostics.
Malformed or hostile inputs, timeouts, resource exhaustion, and worker failures fail safely with bounded diagnostics and no silent success.
Audit evidence records decisions and validation provenance while privacy, retention, and access policy remain open.
An AFP feasibility recommendation requires an agreed input/output target, representative safe fixtures, fidelity criteria, and evidence; conversion is not authorized.

stories.text: As a proposed document-remediation operator, I want a bounded baseline structure repair for supported existing PDFs, so that repair candidates can be assessed without losing characterized content.
As a proposed accessibility reviewer, I want uncertain semantic repairs routed to review with evidence, so that ambiguous structure is not silently guessed.
As a proposed document-operations author, I want validated statement and invoice inputs rendered as semantically structured documents, so that repeatable outputs can be reviewed before release.
As a proposed communications author, I want correspondence and reports rendered from validated inputs with headings and reading order represented, so that readers can navigate the generated content.
As a proposed service operator, I want both lanes to classify failures and retain privacy-aware audit evidence, so that support can distinguish review, retry, and terminal outcomes.
As a proposed AFP print-operations owner, I want a bounded feasibility result for an agreed AFP input/output goal, so that a go/no-go decision can be made before migration is considered.
stories.persona_status: proposed; role, target, and workload unresolved

tests.given: A synthetic statement PDF matches the agreed supported-input profile and baseline fixture
tests.when: The bounded baseline characterization and repair contract is applied
tests.then: A candidate and change manifest are produced; original remains intact and declared preservation observations are available.

tests.given: A synthetic invoice PDF contains declared text, totals, and page geometry
tests.when: It is processed by the proposed baseline repair contract
tests.then: The output is compared against the invoice fixture and any unsupported arithmetic or layout change is reported.

tests.given: A synthetic letter PDF has known language, paragraphs, and reading order
tests.when: It is characterized and repaired within the supported baseline profile
tests.then: Text, page count, links, metadata, and declared structure are compared and unverified semantics remain unverified.

tests.given: A synthetic report PDF contains headings, a table, and a chart caption
tests.when: Baseline repair is attempted
tests.then: Known table and figure semantics are preserved or routed as unsupported; no guessed reading order is reported as correct.

tests.given: A synthetic malformed or encrypted PDF is outside the declared supported profile
tests.when: Intake classifies the file
tests.then: The result is a bounded unsupported/error outcome and no candidate is emitted as successful.

tests.given: An agreed synthetic fixture has baseline text, pages, geometry, links, forms, and annotations
tests.when: A candidate is compared with the baseline
tests.then: Each applicable feature has pass, difference, or unknown evidence; missing checks do not become pass.

tests.given: A synthetic PDF contains ambiguous reading order or table semantics
tests.when: Semantic analysis cannot meet an agreed confidence/decision rule
tests.then: The output is review-needed with uncertainty evidence, not an automatic semantic guess.

tests.given: A repair candidate has unresolved semantic findings
tests.when: The human review gate is evaluated
tests.then: Release remains pending until genuine authorized review evidence is verified. Decision 0015 selects the role-grant source and temporal policy; the named person's release-stage identity verification remains open.

tests.given: A remediation candidate and the accepted PDF/UA-2 output profile are supplied
tests.when: The independent validator is invoked with explicit ua2 profile selection
tests.then: The result records validator/version, profile, candidate identity, and machine outcome; no profile fallback occurs and the result is not a semantic or compliance verdict.

tests.given: A synthetic input and fake validator process are supplied to the Go CI adapter
tests.when: The adapter invokes only explicit ua2 XML validation and classifies the process/report pair
tests.then: Compliant and noncompliant XML are classified consistently; missing, malformed, oversized, mismatched, contradictory, timed-out, or unavailable execution fails closed, and shim results do not represent veraPDF or PDF conformance.

tests.given: The official veraPDF artifact, detached signature, public key, and genuine PDF/UA-2 pass/fail controls are available through an authenticated allowed route
tests.when: The pinned CLI validates each control with explicit --flavour ua2
tests.then: Signer fingerprint, verified signature, local digest, CLI/version, control hashes, and observed outcomes are recorded; no autodetection or fallback is used and no human semantic or AT outcome is inferred.

tests.given: A candidate has machine findings and a human semantic checklist
tests.when: A reviewer assesses reading order, labels, and meaning
tests.then: The semantic decision and unresolved findings are separately recorded from machine results.

tests.given: A candidate is eligible for assistive-technology review under an agreed protocol
tests.when: The review is performed
tests.then: Tool/version, test steps, observed issues, and outcome are recorded separately; no protocol is presumed approved.

tests.given: Synthetic statement data satisfies its proposed field and arithmetic profile
tests.when: The proposed statement renderer is invoked
tests.then: A candidate output, source-to-output manifest, and separately reviewable semantic structure are produced.

tests.given: Synthetic invoice data has line items and declared currency/rounding rules
tests.when: Validation and rendering are requested
tests.then: Totals are checked against the declared rules before a candidate is produced; unresolved policy blocks acceptance.

tests.given: Synthetic correspondence data provides language, title, paragraphs, and recipient fields
tests.when: The proposed renderer processes the template
tests.then: Declared title, headings, language, and reading order are represented and missing bindings are explicit.

tests.given: Synthetic report data includes sections, a table, and provenance metadata
tests.when: The proposed report renderer is invoked
tests.then: Sections and tabular relationships have explicit structure and unmapped values stop or flag rendering.

tests.given: A synthetic input omits a required field or supplies a value with the wrong type
tests.when: Data/template validation runs
tests.then: Field-level findings are returned and rendering does not proceed.

tests.given: A generated candidate is checked against the accepted PDF/UA-2 machine profile
tests.when: Machine validation and human review gates are evaluated
tests.then: Machine validation explicitly requests ua2 with no fallback; machine, semantic, and assistive-technology outcomes remain separate and no single result implies compliance.

tests.given: A synthetic DOCX or Markdown source fixture is supplied
tests.when: Source conversion feasibility is assessed
tests.then: Structure, fidelity, licensing, and unsupported features are documented before support is claimed.

tests.given: No generation engine has an approved evidence record
tests.when: A generation implementation task is considered
tests.then: Engine-dependent work remains decision-blocked until a comparative feasibility decision is recorded.

tests.given: Either lane receives a synthetic hostile metadata or resource-exhaustion fixture
tests.when: The input is processed under a proposed resource policy
tests.then: Processing is bounded and classified with no silent success or content-bearing diagnostic leakage.

tests.given: A synthetic worker exceeds the proposed timeout or crashes
tests.when: The job controller observes the failure
tests.then: The job enters an explicit retry, terminal, or review state and records bounded evidence.

tests.given: A fixture contains a synthetic marker representing sensitive content
tests.when: Errors and audit events are emitted
tests.then: Ordinary diagnostics omit the marker and retention/access policy is clearly left for decision.

tests.given: A job records intake, transformation, validation, and review events
tests.when: An audit record is inspected
tests.then: Event ordering, artifact identity, and decision provenance are traceable without claiming an unselected integrity mechanism.

tests.given: AFP input/output goals, safe representative fixtures, and fidelity criteria are not yet agreed
tests.when: The feasibility issue is refined
tests.then: Missing prerequisites are listed and the go/no-go task stays blocked; no converter is selected or implemented.
